name: Red-headed Manakin
rangeDescription: Tropical eastern peru to northern bolivia, and southern amazonian and eastern brazil
description: A small chunky manakin. Males are mostly black with a red hood while females are olive-green above with a whitish belly.

name: Red-billed Spurfowl
rangeDescription: Southern angola to namibia, botswana, southwestern zambia, and western zimbabwe
description: A medium-sized, brown francolin that is finely barred on the belly, head, and back. It has a diagnostic broad yellow eyering and reddish bill and feet.

name: Sulphur-bellied Tyrant-Manakin
rangeDescription: Tropical eastern peru to northern bolivia and adjacent western amazonian brazil
description: Large, tan manakin. Longer-tailed with a more upright posture than other smaller manakins.

name: Glossy Flowerpiercer
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia to western venezuela, ecuador and far northern peru
description: This glossy-black flowerpiercer has a distinctive silvery patch on the shoulder. Most similar to Black Flowerpiercer, which is smaller and lacks the shoulder patch in most of its range (although in east Andes in Colombia, Black Flowerpiercer has a small gray shoulder patch).

name: Cerulean Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Sangihe islands (northeast of sulawesi)
description: An unmistakable, fairly large blue flycatcher confined to Sangihe island. Entirely pale blue, with a paler belly and a conspicuous white eye-ring which is the most striking identification feature.

name: Santa Cruz White-eye
rangeDescription: Nendö (northern temotu, southeastern solomon islands)
description: Small. Mostly olive-green with a paler underside and darker wings.

name: Sira Barbet
rangeDescription: Southern cerros del sira, ucayali, peru
description: Stunning and rarely seen bird known only from the remote Cerros del Sira range in central Peru, east of the main chain of the Andes. Easily identified by its scarlet crown, breast, and flanks as well as white throat and belly.

name: Spangled Cotinga
rangeDescription: Southern venezuela and the guianas to northern bolivia and amazonian brazil
description: Compact, medium-sized bird of rainforest canopy; often seen at fruiting trees or perched atop bare snags. Male plumage is stunning in good light but can appear blackish otherwise.

name: Javan Shortwing
rangeDescription: Mountains of java
description: A small, dark songster of montane rainforest floor and undergrowth on Java. Male is overall slaty-gray but slightly paler on the belly.

name: Guianan Gnatcatcher
rangeDescription: The guianas (guyana, suriname, and french guiana) southward to the amazon river
description: Inconspicuous and rarely seen bird of rainforest canopy. Small and slender with a long tail; mostly dark gray with a broken white eyering, white belly, and white outer tail feathers.

name: Enggano Cuckoo-Dove
rangeDescription: Enggano (off southwestern sumatra)
description: Brown cuckoo-dove, endemic to Enggano Island, off Sumatra’s southwest coast. Gingery-brown, with distinctively blotchy, “scaled”-looking chest and upperparts.

name: Sumba Green-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Lowlands of sumba island (western lesser sundas)
description: A green pigeon with striking yellowish markings and edgings on the wing. Male has a chestnut lower back, while the back of the female is entirely green.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Purus Jacamar
rangeDescription: Tropical eastern peru, northern bolivia, and western amazonian brazil
description: Distinctive dark jacamar with a heavy bill and short tail. Deep chocolate brown, with a pinkish bill and reddish skin around the eye.

name: Comb Duck
rangeDescription: Tropical south america (east of the andes) to northern argentina
description: Large bicolored waterbird. Both sexes are iridescent purplish-green above with a white breast.

name: Peruvian Plantcutter
rangeDescription: Coastal northwestern peru (tumbes southward to northern lima)
description: Scarce cotinga restricted to dry lowland forest in northwestern Peru. Male is gray with a reddish belly and forehead and white wingbars.

name: Five-colored Munia
rangeDescription: Lesser sundas
description: A striking finch with a heavy silvery bill, a dark coppery hood, a brilliant white underside, and chestnut upperparts. Juveniles duller, with paler head and browner upperparts.

name: Palmchat
rangeDescription: Hispaniola, including gonâve and saona islands
description: A small but conspicuous noisy species found in a variety of open and disturbed habitats that contain palms; often found in small flocks high in palm trees. Its appearance is unique within its range; note its dark brown upperparts combined with heavily streaked white underparts, a pale thickset bill, and a brilliant red eye.

name: New Caledonian Grassbird
rangeDescription: Grassland and open heath of new caledonia
description: Extremely shy, smallish, long-tailed brown songbird, found locally throughout New Caledonia. When seen, note warm brown upperparts and flanks contrasting strongly with a white eyebrow, throat, and belly.

name: Cameroon Pigeon
rangeDescription: Highland forest of eastern nigeria and southwestern cameroon
description: A large dark purple-gray pigeon with distinctive white spots on the breast and back, a blue-gray head, and a bright red-and-yellow bill. Often seen flying over the canopy in transit or during display flights, and sometimes perches conspicuously in the open.
imageCreditName: Stu Elsom - Stuart Elsom Ecology / Rockjumper Birding Tours

name: Rodrigues Warbler
rangeDescription: Rodrigues (eastern mascarene islands); seriously endangered
description: A medium-sized yellowish-olive bird with a long tail that is often flipped up and down. Endemic to the remote island of Rodrigues.
